say:1:1631931001:1.source_cn: 喵呜！我将去图书馆进修。

say:2:1631931002:1.text: I'm going to get some tips from the library ghost on how to get people's attention.
say:2:1631931002:1.source_cn: 向那位图书馆幽灵请教怎样才能引起大家的注意。
say:2:1631931002:1.male: I'm going to get some tips from the library ghost on how to get people's attention.
say:2:1631931002:1.female: I'm going to get some tips from the library ghost on how to get people's attention.

say:3:1631931003:1.text: I want everyone to know my name, meow!
say:3:1631931003:1.source_cn: 这样下次大家就都能看见派特啦，喵！
say:3:1631931003:1.male: I want everyone to know my name, meow!
say:3:1631931003:1.female: I want everyone to know my name, meow!
